'''Version 1.0.0.0''' is the patch released on 25 November 2026, announced as '''1.0 - Leaving Early Access!''' The [https://steamstore-a.akamaihd.net/news/externalpost/steam_community_announcements/1850460852980209 official Steam announcement] was posted at 08:02:15 UTC and ends Early Access. The installed public game's menu, version check and save writer identify the binary as '''1.0.0.0'''. The wiki now shows values from [[Version 1.0.1.0]]; this page retains the 1.0 release's history.

This page describes the public release's changes from [[Version 0.9.6.5]]. Gameplay descriptions and item statistics throughout the wiki cover the current stable release.

'''Spoilers:''' this page names creatures, a new cave and late-story achievement milestones.

== New content ==
=== Items ===
The release adds '''13 item definitions''' compared with 0.9.6.5. The announcement's "around 20" is approximate.

{| class="wikitable"
! Group !! Items
|-
| Shields and armor || [[Iron Shield]], [[Iron Chestplate]], [[Steel Buckler]], [[Wooden Shield]]
|-
| Weapons || [[Battle Hammer]], [[Halfmoon Axe]], [[War Mace]], [[Hand Sickle]], [[Sturdy Shortbow]]
|-
| Clothing || [[Well Tailored Socks]], [[Laughable Socks]], [[Well Tailored Shirt]], [[Well Tailored Pants]]
|}

Only Sturdy Shortbow has a crafting recipe among these additions. Declared prices do not establish merchant stock, and random-treasure eligibility still depends on type, size, value budgets and other checks.

=== Steam achievements ===
[[Achievements]] explains 14 unique checks covering journal milestones, Permadeath, map collection, survival days and selected enemy deaths. Its condition labels are not official Steam display names, and actual Steam unlocking has not been tested. Existing saves are not uniformly retroactive.

=== German and combat music ===
German is available through the fifth language flag, with five packaged language files. Map-title font selection and language-switch refresh ordering are corrected; Russian-specific font branches do not establish a newly shipped Russian translation folder.

Missing translation keys can be filled without replacing existing translations. One additional combat track joins the existing combat-music list. The menu receives 1.0 branding, and existing click-sound volumes are rebalanced.

== Changes ==
=== Spider-cave access and exposure ===
[[World generation]] can assign the special spider-cave entrance in newly generated areas. The replacement roll is 0.333 '''for eligible ordinary cave candidates''' after selection and collision checks, not one cave in three areas. Saved terrain is not regenerated.

The cave layout, webs, treasure, [[Mirk Lurker]] and [[Deathlob]] definitions already existed in 0.9.6.5. The functional entrance in 1.0 makes them ordinarily reachable without adding two new enemy definitions or changing their base stats.

The cave is dungeon-like as well as cave-like. Its HUD uses the underground indicator without weather overlays; [[Temperature]] and [[Weather]] use a 0.35 ambient baseline for player warmth and container drying before other modifiers. This does not remove every weather influence from wetness calculations.

The ordinary [[Areas|population updater]] still exits for this nonoutside area before its later dungeon fallback. The classification change does not establish additional ordinary inhabitants; initial cave generation retains relative Mirk Lurker:Deathlob weights of 15:1. Outside Deathlob selection weights of 0.125 in [[Sunken Ancient Ruins]] and 0.1 in the general outside pool remain relative weights, not encounter percentages.

=== Crafting and treasure ===
Sturdy Shortbow is craftable in the player's menu from 2 [[Twine]], 2 [[Branch (Trollgnarl)]] and 10 [[Spider Silk]] for 8 base AP. A burning [[Campfire]] offers [[Grilled Spider Meat]]: 1 [[Spider Meat]] into 1 grilled meat for 2.4 base AP. [[Survivor's Field Kit]] does not receive that cooking recipe.

[[Loot tables]] can consider item IDs through the new bow. Normal exclusions, cell-size limits, budget checks and the candidate limit remain; this does not guarantee every new item in every pool.

[[Crafting]] XP rounds half the actual modified AP cost up, then applies the existing level reduction. Twine starts at 1 XP. An actual 2.4-AP craft below level 5 grants 2 XP; an 8-AP craft grants 4.

=== Rafts ===
[[Finish Raft]] has a 6-AP base action cost instead of 6.4 and provides Push, Pull and Board. Push and Pull cost 6 AP; a blocked push still spends AP. Direct boarding requires being within 8 pixels and enters the rafting state. Movement is gradual, and frozen rafts stop bobbing. Movement targets are not saved, so continuing an in-progress push or pull after loading is unconfirmed.

=== Honey, trees and ground cover ===
[[Honey]] replenishment has an outer 50% attempt gate, a total-resource limit of 4.25, fewer than one resource per eligible tree, at least 12 branches and a nested 1.5% tree roll. These are not a 50% per-tree drop chance or a guaranteed minimum distance between honey-bearing trees.

[[Tree health and chopping|Tree branch death chance]] is quartered within the 16-pixel view margin. Activated almost-dead trees outside that margin have a 1% removal check. Nearby existing log count and placement conditions determine possible replacement logs; a dead tree is removed even if no logs are placed. Logs are not guaranteed.

Log scattering checks the candidate position correctly. [[Fern]] can regrow on outside-area revisits, except in Rift-Thorn Mire, over at most 10 elapsed day iterations with up to 256 candidate searches each. This is not log growth.

== Fixes ==
* Equipped torch fuel no longer provides the faulty direct-equipped fuel search; nearby ground fuel remains usable and tool searches still include equipped tools.
* Closing a submenu clears its secondary selected slot.
* Hidden-hollow placement checks container collisions at the placement origin. It is not a blanket collision scan over every container in the footprint.
* Jump completion preserves its visual height target after halting the path, addressing the endless deep-water-fall issue.
* Poison damage-number opacity follows its cell opacity, and the ones digit uses modulo 10.
* Cured sickness resets its remaining time instead of accidentally adding 0.16 wellbeing. Existing sickness levels retain their 1%, 2% and 3% penalties.
* Non-English new-game map titles use the corrected font selection; the debug font contains 204 glyphs.

'''Not in the patch notes:''' the spider cave uses dungeon-like exposure; language changes refresh the UI before the menu. Tree-part drawing samples, offscreen being draw culling and highlighting changes are graphical, not despawn or tree-growth guarantees. Developer item-picker expansion is not a player feature. The save format adds no serialized fields beyond its updated version literal.
